Name: Sebastian Frog Tank Switch
Author: Shaklin
Description:
A simple Mod to add or remove Sebastians Frog tank.

Only the Host can control this.
So clients can not manipulate your savegame.


[size=4]How it works:[/size]
Open [b]config.json[/b]

To remove frog tank set it to [b]false[/b]:
[code]{
  "Frog_Tank_Allowed": false
}[/code]

To add frog tank set it to [b]true[/b]:
[code]{
  "Frog_Tank_Allowed": true
}[/code]

You must sleep to save it.
Re-enter the room. Done!

--------------
If you not want to use this mod, but you want to remove the frog tank manually, then
open your savegame and delete this:
<string>sebastianFrog</string>
